arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) AS month, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE t.date >= '2019-01-01' AND t.date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate among labelled transactions for each month from January to October 2019.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (inner join to fraud_labels); unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Months are calendar months of 2019, from 2019-01-01 through 2019-10-31.
